newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin still a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers/Patrimonio said in a report it was maintaining their buy rating on Brazilian pulp and paper company Klabin.
-- It said Klabin reported 1996 results of $51.3 million, which were lower than their forecast of $78 million.

-- However, they maintained their rating on the stock based on expected future higher earnings stemming from a price upcycle for the industry in early 1998 and the company's focus on the Brazilian tissue and packaging paper market niche.
-- Klabin preferred shares were flat at 1.04 reais.
